THE WEST PAKISTAN PREVENTION OF CRUELTY TO ANIMALS RULES, 1961
THE WEST PAKISTAN PREVENTION OF CRUELTY TO ANIMALS RULES,
1961
No. H-2-15-80 AH-I-AD-6.- In exercise of the powers conferred by sub section
(1) of Section 15 of the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act, 1890 (XI of
1890), the Governor of West Pakistan is pleased to make the following rules, a
draft whereof was published in the Gazette of West Pakistan 1961, Part I, pages
226 and 227 under the Agriculture Department Notification No. X-2, 15-S0
AH-I-AD-60, dated the 20th April, 1961.
1. Short title and commencement.-- (1) These
rules may be called the West Pakistan Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Rules,
1961.
(2) They shall come into force at
once.
2. Definitions.-- In these rules, unless the context otherwise
requires, the following expressions shall have the meaning hereby respectively
assigned to them, that is to say:
(a) "recognised
society' means a society declared to be such under rule 3;
(b) "summer" means the season commencing on the 1st day of
May and ending on the 15th day of October; and
(c) "winter" means the season commencing on the 16th day of
October and ending on the 30th day of April.
3. Recognition of Societies.-- Government may, by notification, declare any society
registered under the Societies Registration Act, 1860, whose object is the
prevention of cruelty to animals, to be a recognised society under the rules in
respect of any specified area or areas.
4. Farriers to be licensed.-- No person
shall carry on the business of a farrier in the area of a recognised society
except under a licence issued by such society.
5. Conditions on which
farriers to be licensed.-- Licences under rule 3 shall be issued on payment
of a fee of rupees five per annum and shall be subject to such terms and
conditions as may be provided in the by-laws and regulations of the recognised
society issuing the same.
6. Fees to be accounted for.-- The fees
realized by a recognised society shall be kept in such custody and dealt with
in such manner as Government may direct.
7. Bits or harness for
animals.-- No person shall use any bit or harness which may or which is
likely to cause an injury to the animal or whom it is used.
8. Draught hours for buffaloes.-- No person
shall use buffaloes for draught purposes from 10 a.m. to 4 p.m. in summer and
from 11 a.m. to 2. p.m. in winter.
9. Restriction on loading.--
No person shall load an animal or an animal-driven vehicle specified in the
second column of the Schedule to these rules which a load in excess of that
specified against such animals or animal-driven vehicle in the third column
thereof.
10. Age of service.-- No person
shall use any animal in yoke which is less than 4 years or more than 16 years
of age.
